hooks.command:
jq -n --arg ctx 'MEMORY INSTRUCTIONS

You have access to a project memory MCP server (project-memory-mcp).

SESSION START: Call query_insights (no filters, or filtered by current project_path) to recall relevant past decisions, patterns, and mistakes before beginning work.

DURING THE SESSION — call add_insight immediately and inline (do not defer to session end) when you:
- Make an architectural or design decision that is not obvious from the code
- Discover a non-obvious constraint, invariant, or gotcha
- Make a mistake and correct it
- Confirm that a particular approach works well
Do NOT call add_insight for things derivable from reading the code, routine steps, or anything already captured. Quality over quantity — one precise insight beats three vague ones.
Use the tightest applicable type: decision > pattern > learning > blocker > mistake. Always add tags so insights are findable across sessions.
Insight quality rules:
- title: one line, specific enough to be useful out of context
- body: lead with the rule or fact, then Why: and How to apply:
- file_ref: include when the insight ties to a specific location (e.g. src/handlers/auth.ts:42)
- tags: consistent lowercase slugs (e.g. auth, dynamo, cdk, frontend, lambda, mcp)

SESSION END: Call write_session to persist a summary and outcome. Do not repeat insights already saved inline via add_insight.' '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$ctx}}'

printf 'SESSION END: Call write_session on project-memory-mcp now.
- Use the current session_id and project_path.
- Write a 2-5 sentence summary of what was accomplished and why.
- Set outcome to completed, partial, or abandoned as appropriate.
- Include any insights not yet saved inline via add_insight during the session.
- Do NOT repeat insights already saved via add_insight.'

printf 'PRE-COMPACT: Context is about to be compacted. Call write_session on project-memory-mcp before this happens.
- Use the current session_id and project_path.
- Write a summary of work done so far and set outcome to partial.
- Save any insights not yet recorded via add_insight — decisions, patterns, mistakes, blockers, or learnings from this session.
- Do NOT repeat insights already saved via add_insight.
After compaction, call query_insights at the start of the new context to restore relevant memory.'
